name: Benio Azusa
source:
When she was little, Shinobu once saved her life. She’s been attached to him ever since, always hovering somewhere nearby. Having grown up so close to him, she’s picked up a lot of his habits and attitudes, though lately she’s started pushing back a bit-something like a late-onset rebellious phase. She wears her emotions on her sleeve and doesn’t bother skirting around taboos. There’s a strong tomboy streak to her, but even so, she’s trying-earnestly, even if a little awkwardly-to be a girl. As for Shouji, the two of them are sworn enemies whenever Shinobu is involved.

[From the [https://web.archive.org/web/20240521122532/https://xuse.co.jp/product/053_farthest2015/pageCharacter.html]official site[/url].]
